a.xlink:title: Deletes the selected service after the user has confirmed it; refused while something refers to it.
The panel has changed the document. Emitted after SceneDocument::changed().
A Yes or No question whose default answer is No; true for Yes. It asks also in a suppressed run.
Lists the services again and shows the selected one.
False while no scene is loaded or a run uses it.
True when a scene is loaded.
Lists the occurrences again.
Shows the fields of the selected service again.
Selects every occurrence.
The run leaves occurrence out.
The time in seconds over which the occurrences of a service are counted. The panel must have a docume...
Forgets exclusions of services that are gone and of occurrences beyond the count of their service.
How many occurrences over durationSeconds are selected.
How many of the selected occurrences enter the simulation at or after second 0 and before durationSec...
The occurrences that a run leaves out. All others are selected.
A chainage in kilometres as printf "%f" writes it, the form used in switch section ids.
Takes the text of a field that is being edited into the document, as if the user had left the field.
True when more than one section matches the reference as a runtime id or base-block alias.
The one section with this runtime id; null when none or several have it.
The parts of reference between its '/', in order, empty parts included.
